events.author: 7ZMh_2s_IOTPiKoZ6K5eDe4AclTYh_JzqJ7pK2lovT4
events.body:
1a. HD BCH address derivation — the heaviest new piece (new module src/bch_hd.py)
Pure-Python (Pyodide has no npm/secp256k1 lib). Derive <xpub>/index (single non-hardened child; the supplied xpub is the external/receive node, e.g. m/44'/145'/0'/0):

base58check-decode xpub → version/chaincode/33-byte compressed pubkey.
BIP32 CKDpub: I = HMAC-SHA512(chaincode, pubkey||ser32(index)); child point = IL·G + parentPoint via hand-rolled secp256k1 modular point add/double (big-int math, ~80 lines).
hash160 = RIPEMD160(SHA256(pubkey)). SHA-256 via WebCrypto (js_crypto); RIPEMD160 pure-Python (~70 lines) since Pyodide/WebCrypto lacks it.
CashAddr encode (bitcoincash: prefix, BCH base32 + polymod checksum, ~60 lines).
Validate output against existing BCH_RE as a sanity check. Add a focused unit test in cloudflare_worker/tests/ with a known BIP32 vector. Read XPUB from env; if unset, fail the donation-address endpoint with a clear xpub_not_configured error (no silent fallback).
